title: Party marker stream is not authoritative membership evidence
action: party markers appear and disappear without handle-bearing lifecycle evidence

sensitivityHandling.notes: Marker IDs and tracked entities are synthetic and intentionally not linked to handles.

expectedNonEvents.reason: A marker appearing does not prove a named member joined.
A marker disappearing does not prove a named member left.
Marker removal is not kick or removal evidence.
All markers disappearing is not direct disband evidence.
Marker count is not authoritative party size evidence.

correlation.notes: Marker records may be retained as diagnostic evidence after event contracts exist, but they must not mutate named membership.

knownLimitations: No handle mapping is present; this fixture intentionally does not assert PartyMarkerObserved as a promoted canonical event.
verificationNotes: Parser/profile tests should assert marker-only records do not create, remove, or count party members.
